mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user_channel_credential WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND channel_code = #{channel}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_channel_credential SET enabled = 0, current_version_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_channel_credential_version v WHERE v.credential_id = #{id} AND v.id IN ()
